entries.zh: 空劳；徒劳白费、劳而无功
entries.en: useless labour; work done in vain

entries.zh: 空走；白跑一趟、徒劳往返
entries.en: to run in vain; a fruitless errand

entries.zh: 空做；白做一场、徒劳无功
entries.en: to work in vain; labour to no effect

entries.zh: 空发业；白白兴办事业、创业徒劳无成
entries.en: an undertaking begun in vain; fruitless venturing (发业＝创立事业)

entries.zh: 空白；徒然无获、落得一场空
entries.en: all for nothing; in vain and empty-handed

entries.zh: 急难；急难危困、紧迫的患难
entries.en: urgent distress; pressing calamity
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节声调号污损（T99），词形可辨；释义据汉栏急难与 L trabajo grande 互证。

entries.zh: 劳尽；劳碌至极、困惫不堪
entries.en: utter weariness; exhausting toil

entries.zh: 劳创；劳苦伤身、操劳致损（犹“劳伤”）
entries.en: overwork injury; toil that wears and wounds the body

entries.zh: 坎坷；坎坷不平、遭遇困顿不顺
entries.en: rough going; frustrated, chequered with hardship

entries.zh: 艰苦；艰难困苦、辛劳不易
entries.en: hardship; arduous and bitter toil

entries.zh: 艰辛；艰辛劳苦、度日维艰
entries.en: toil and hardship; a hard lot

entries.zh: 艰计；艰难筹谋、劳心费力之谋算
entries.en: laborious scheming; a hard, painstaking undertaking
entries.notes: “艰计”非习见复合词，据 L trabajo 与字面“艰＋计”推断为费力求谋之义，存推断成分。

entries.zh: 空行；空行白走、徒劳无获
entries.en: to walk/go in vain; a futile trip
entries.notes: 西栏 trabajo de la obra（工程劳作）与汉栏“空行”义不合，疑原稿对位错行；释义以汉字与音写为准。

entries.zh: 苦难；苦难磨折、困苦灾厄
entries.en: suffering and tribulation; misery

entries.zh: 困苦；困顿穷苦、苦楚难支
entries.en: hardship and distress; afflicted poverty

entries.zh: 灾殃（原稿作“灾秧”）；灾祸殃及、苦难之灾
entries.en: calamity and scourge; woe (秧 is a popular variant of 殃)
entries.notes: “秧”为“殃”之俗写借字，义即灾殃；与 L trabajo, miseria 相合。

entries.zh: 无快活；不快活、愁闷不乐
entries.en: joyless; unhappy, downcast and sorrowful

entries.zh: 苦楚；苦痛楚楚、困苦难堪
entries.en: suffering; bitter pain and distress

entries.zh: 亏心（首字或作“痨”）；愧心负疚、心中劳苦不安
entries.en: a guilty conscience; inward weariness and remorse
entries.notes: 汉栏存疑〔亏/痨〕；音写 cui 与“亏”相合，取“亏心＝负疚、心劳”义配 L trabajo 之劳苦义。

entries.zh: 患难；灾难祸患、困厄临身（并录“灾难”）
entries.en: tribulation and calamity; distress, upheaval
entries.notes: 西栏残损且首词存疑〔darbo/danno〕；M 栏末组“boe chay”疑为“无灾”，义不属同义而待考。
